title: Mexican Chicken Fajita
description: A classic Mexican dish, easy to make and packed with flavor. Served with warm flour tortillas.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook for 2-3 minutes until they start to soften.
Add the sliced peppers and cook for another 2-3 minutes until they start to soften.
Add the chicken breast and cook for 5-6 minutes per side until it's cooked through.
Stir in the Mexican-style fondue and cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt, pepper, and dried oregano.
Serve warm flour tortillas on the side and assemble the fajitas.
